steps.text: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
Already planning your comeback?
Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
The rematch can wait
I really liked playing with you yesterday
You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
You were learning. And you got better
I know. I want another try soon ❤️
Any time
Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
What's up?
I have a presentation to prepare for university
The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
Come over after your day. You can practise with me
You'd sit through it?
Of course. What is it about?
Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
Then bring your notes
Okay ❤️
University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
Ready for the first part
Looking very prepared
The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
You'll be fine
You have to listen properly tonight, though
No distracting me halfway through
I'll save it for after
I walked right into that one 😌
I'll let you know when I can get away from work
Have a good morning, love
You too ❤️
